resources.string: Your JeduAI web address, e.g. https://school.example.com
Please enter a valid address, like https://your-jeduai-server.com
JeduAI is self-hosted: this app is the frame — the address below is where the actual app, your account and your data live. You only enter it once.
Where do I find this address?
1. Open JeduAI in any web browser — the same link you already use (your school\'s link or your preview).
2. Copy the address from the browser\'s address bar. In the app: Profile → Get the app → \"Your server address\".
3. Paste it here and tap Connect. Done.
Testing on your own computer? Run JeduAI there (bun run dev) and enter its Wi-Fi address, like http://192.168.1.5:3000
Check your internet connection and the server address, then try again.
